title: How to Report Cybercrime — National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
publisher: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
text: The Government of India operates the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal at cybercrime.gov.in and a dedicated helpline number 1930. Any victim of online financial fraud — including UPI scam, OTP theft, phishing, fake loan offers, impersonation fraud, or investment fraud — can file a complaint at this portal. Time is critical: reporting within the first few hours of a fraud significantly increases the chance of freezing the fraudulent transaction and recovering money. Steps to report: (1) Call 1930 immediately after noticing fraud. Provide your bank name, account number, and approximate amount lost. (2) File a formal complaint at cybercrime.gov.in — select 'Financial Fraud' under 'Report Cyber Crime'. (3) Also contact your bank's fraud helpline directly to request a transaction hold. (4) Save all evidence: screenshots of messages, transaction IDs, UPI reference numbers, and call logs. The portal handles: UPI/IMPS/NEFT fraud, credit/debit card fraud, online job scams, loan app fraud, matrimonial scams, and investment fraud. Complaints filed here are routed to the appropriate state police for investigation.
